name: Solve this quantum programming problem. Write a Braket program building an 3-qub
task_prompt: Solve this quantum programming problem. Write a Braket program building an 3-qubit GHZ circuit, print the circuit diagram, and verify with the state_vector result type that only |0...0> and |1...1> have amplitude. Write the full runnable code (all imports included); executing it should print the results.
